Try it out

The fastest way to see what EpiSODIC does, with no data or configuration of your own required.

episodic_demo()
Try EpiSODIC With Synthetic Outbreak Data

Run EpiSODIC

The two calls that run a real instance: detect on a schedule, and open the dashboard for your board to review the results.

episodic_run_cron()
Run One Surveillance Detection Cycle
episodic_run_app()
Open the EpiSODIC Dashboard
